mapper.select:
/* isry.sample.mapper.DynamicReplyBoardMapper.selectDynamicReplyBoardList 공통팀 유민상 */ WITH TEMP AS ( SELECT A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_SN , 0 AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_TTL_NM , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS FRST_REG_DT , A.RDCNT_NOCS , A.FRST_RGTR_ID , C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(A.FRST_RGTR_ID) AS FRST_RGTR_NM , A.ATFINO , (SELECT COUNT(MNG_SN) FROM SAB821 WHERE ATFINO = A.ATFINO AND FILE_STTS_SE_CD != 'D' AND ATCMFL_CL_NM = '0') AS ATFI_CNT , A.RLS_YN , CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE - A.FRST_REG_DT) > 1 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS NEW_BBSCTT , A.NTC_MATTER_YN AS NTC_MATTER_YN , '1' AS DEPTH_LEVEL , A.BBSCTT_CN FROM SBA110 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT B.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , '' AS BBSCTT_SN , B.RETE_ESNTAL_NO , 'RE : ' || B.RETE_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM , TO_CHAR(B.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS FRST_REG_DT , B.RDCNT_NOCS , B.RETE_WRTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID , DEC_B64(SA_FN_GET_NAME(B.RETE_WRTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM , B.ATFINO , (SELECT COUNT(MNG_SN) FROM SAB821 WHERE ATFINO = B.ATFINO AND FILE_STTS_SE_CD != 'D' AND ATCMFL_CL_NM = '0') AS ATFI_CNT , (SELECT MAX(C.RLS_YN) FROM SBA110 C WHERE C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) AS RLS_YN , CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE - B.FRST_REG_DT) > 1 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS NEW_BBSCTT , 'N' AS NTC_MATTER_YN , '2' AS DEPTH_LEVEL , C.BBSCTT_CN FROM SBA112 B INNER JOIN SBA110 C ON C.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = B.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE 1=1 AND B.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND NVL(B.DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y'
) , TEMP2 AS ( SELECT A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AS RETE_ESNTAL_NO
, '|'||LISTAGG (A.NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) AS NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID_LIST , '|'||LISTAGG (A.NTABRD_COL_CN,'|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) AS NTABRD_COL_CN_LIST
/* , MAX(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH (A.NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID, '|')) AS NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID_LIST */ /* , MAX(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH (A.NTABRD_COL_CN,'|')) AS NTABRD_COL_CN_LIST */
FROM ( SELECT A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO , A.NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID , A.NTABRD_COL_CN ,(ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO ,A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ,A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO ORDER BY A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO, A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, A.NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID )) RNUM FROM SBA120 A WHERE 1=1 AND NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' ) A /* START WITH A.RNUM = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR A.RNUM = (A.RNUM - 1) AND PRIOR A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO AND PRIOR A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND PRIOR A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO = A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO */ GROUP BY A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO, A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO, A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) OVER() AS TOT_CNT , COUNT(*) OVER() AS REAL_TOT_CNT , C.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , C.BBSCTT_SN , C.RETE_ESNTAL_NO , C.BBSCTT_TTL_NM , C.FRST_REG_DT , C.RDCNT_NOCS , C.FRST_RGTR_ID , C.FRST_RGTR_NM , C.ATFINO , C.ATFI_CNT , C.RLS_YN , C.HIGH_LIGHT_YN , C.NEW_BBSCTT , C.DEPTH_LEVEL , D.NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID_LIST , D.NTABRD_COL_CN_LIST FROM ( SELECT A.* , 'Y' AS HIGH_LIGHT_YN FROM TEMP A WHERE NTC_MATTER_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT B.* , 'N' AS HIGH_LIGHT_YN FROM TEMP B ) C, TEMP2 D WHERE 1=1 AND C.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = D.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO(+) AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = D.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) AND C.RETE_ESNTAL_NO = D.RETE_ESNTAL_NO(+)
AND C.DEPTH_LEVEL = #{REPLY_YN}
AND (C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO IN ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM TEMP WHERE BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' AND DEPTH_LEVEL = '1' ) OR BBSCTT_CN LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%')
AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO IN ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM TEMP WHERE BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' AND DEPTH_LEVEL = '1' )
AND BBSCTT_CN LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO IN ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM TEMP WHERE FRST_RGTR_NM = #{SEARCH_DATA} AND DEPTH_LEVEL = '1' )
AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO IN ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM TEMP WHERE BBSCTT_SN = #{SEARCH_DATA} AND DEPTH_LEVEL = '1' )
AND (FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN #{START_DATE} AND #{END_DATE})
AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO IN ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM TEMP E WHERE DEPTH_LEVEL = '1' AND ( SELECT NTABRD_COL_CN FROM SBA120 WHERE BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = E.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND RETE_ESNTAL_NO = E.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AND NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID = #{item.KEY} ) LIKE '%' || #{item.VALUE} || '%' )
AND C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO IN ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM TEMP E WHERE DEPTH_LEVEL = '1' AND ( SELECT NTABRD_COL_CN FROM SBA120 WHERE BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = E.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND RETE_ESNTAL_NO = E.RETE_ESNTAL_NO AND NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID = #{item.KEY} ) = #{item.VALUE} )
ORDER BY C.HIGH_LIGHT_YN DESC, C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC, C.RETE_ESNTAL_NO

/* 공통팀 유민상 isry.sample.mapper.DynamicReplyBoardMapper.selectDynamicReplyBoardReplyList 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , RETE_ESNTAL_NO , RETE_WRTR_ID , DEC_B64(SA_FN_GET_NAME(RETE_WRTR_ID)) AS RETE_WRTR_NM , RETE_TTL_NM , RETE_CN , ATFINO , RDCNT_NOCS , FRST_REG_DT FROM SBA112 WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' AND NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
